Learn moreSign in Comments Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description How I'd Start Crypto Trading Today 49Likes1,950ViewsJan 102026 If you want to get started in crypto, the first step isn’t buying a random coin—it’s education. Start by learning the basics. Find two or three solid crypto podcasts that consistently talk about industry trends, not hype. Read a few beginner-friendly crypto books so you understand what blockchain, wallets, and tokens actually are. You can also go back and listen to the crypto episodes I’ve done over the last several years to see how the space has evolved. At some point, learning becomes experiential. If you’ve got $500 or $1,000 you’re willing to risk, consider buying one of the major, established coins like Bitcoin, Ethereum, or other top-tier projects. Not as a gamble—but as a learning tool. Watching how the market moves, how volatility feels, and how custody works teaches you more than theory ever will. Crypto isn’t about getting rich overnight.
